Dear Ahmed Alhabshi,
Thanks for your support and patience, according to our records your issue/query has been resolved for case # 0422163, the case is now closed.
Problem Description
: Charger is stuck
Resolution
: Earlier the charger is running on a very old firmware version. v3.0.2. After updating to the latest firmware version, the charger is not in stuck mode and monitored, that the charger is able to perform multiple successful charging session.
If you need any further assistance, please do reach back out to us by submitting a new request at
www.siemens.com/emobility-service-request
Kindly note that email responses to closed tickets are not monitored.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Shrey Sharma
